Adds another fill or stroke to the object's appearance, each with its own colour, opacity, weight and effects, drawn under the main fill or over the main stroke, as Illustrator's Appearance panel does; index replaces an entry, remove takes one out, clear empties the list.

Combines closed shapes: Add unites them, Subtract cuts the front shapes out of the back one, Intersect keeps their overlap, Exclude Overlap keeps the parts that do not overlap, Minus Back cuts the back shapes out of the front one. Divide splits them into every separate face, each in the colour of the shape on top there; Trim removes the hidden parts of each shape; Merge trims and joins touching shapes of the same fill; Crop keeps what lies inside the front shape; Outline gives each face's edges as strokes in its fill colour.
